lines.zh: 紫的泥，走在夜里几乎看不见。
lines.en: Purple clay. At night I nearly vanish.
I walk at the back of the line.
Silent. Light steps.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧面去，不走正面。
lines.en: I take the flank, not the front.
My color deepens in the dark.
I follow the shadow ahead.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边看有没有人注意。
lines.en: Walking and checking who's watching.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方没什么痕迹。
lines.en: I leave little trace.

lines.zh: 紫色的步子，比看着轻快。
lines.en: Purple steps, lighter than they look.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢正面，我喜欢旁边。
lines.en: Not the front. The side.
I head for your back.

lines.zh: 我的关节在动，没有声音。
lines.en: My joints move silently.
Crouched in the corner. Still.

lines.zh: 紫色是染上去的，我原来的颜色是灰。
lines.en: Purple was dyed on. I was grey before.
Waiting for someone to take a wrong turn.

lines.zh: 我的手已经磨得没棱角了。
lines.en: My hands have worn smooth.

lines.zh: 这地方的光线对我有利。
lines.en: The light here favors me.

lines.zh: 我数着侧面有几个入口。
lines.en: Counting the entrances on this flank.

lines.zh: 紫色染的黏土，站得笔直。
lines.en: Purple-dyed clay, standing straight.
I keep the weapon behind me.
No need to look. Hearing is enough.

lines.zh: 身上的紫深一塊浅一塊。
lines.en: Purple in patches, light and dark.
You haven't noticed me on your flank.
Only my eyes moved.

lines.zh: 你要往哪边走？我猜到了。
lines.en: Which way will you go? I've guessed.
Your gaze passed over me. It didn't stop.

lines.zh: 我站的位置，正好是死角。
lines.en: I'm standing in a blind spot.
Turning around won't help.

lines.zh: 我这样看着，是等你转身背对。
lines.en: I watch like this until you turn your back.
The light on you is too bright.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脚步节奏了。
lines.en: I've learned your walking rhythm.
No hurry to be seen.

lines.zh: 你把手放在刀柄上，太早。
lines.en: Your hand's on the hilt. Too early.

lines.zh: 我的脸在阴影里，只有一点紫色。
lines.en: My face in shadow. Only a hint of purple.
I fall back and relocate.

lines.zh: 这一下暴露了我的角度。
lines.en: That showed my angle.
A piece of clay broke off my shoulder.
I make no sound. I endure.
You got me from the front.
Back behind the pillar.
A layer of my purple is gone.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了你出手的方向。
lines.en: I noted where that came from.

lines.zh: 我换了个入口，重新开始。
lines.en: New entrance. Starting again.
You can't see me. I'm here.
Clay soldiers need no food.

lines.zh: 你举着它，暴露了自己的位置。
lines.en: Holding that out. You've shown your position.

lines.zh: 这东西能把你的手占住。
lines.en: That keeps your hands busy.
You're distracted. Good for me.
Put it down. It'd be easier.
Not hungry. Curious.
You turned your back. Good.
It doesn't shine. That's a flaw.
Let's see how long you hold it.
One tremor and I move.
You walked into my corner.
I press back to the wall. Same spot.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的位置暴露了。
lines.en: Now my position is known.
I slip under your elbow.
You touched my shoulder. Cool.
I retreat behind the pillar.
A little clay fell. Very light sound.

lines.zh: 我们贴得很近，你还是没看清。
lines.en: This close and you still haven't seen clearly.

lines.zh: 你把我的颜色蹭到身上了。
lines.en: You got my color on you.
I go around to another entrance.
I was dyed into this.
Not a clay soldier's business.

lines.zh: 你站到光里，我才看得清。
lines.en: Stand in the light so I can see.
I'm not used to being approached.
Half a step back is enough.
My position matters more.
You talk too loudly.
Another purple one? Haven't seen one.
I slip back to the pillar.
Take that direction. I won't follow.
I pick it up in the dark.
I didn't let it make a sound.
It fits behind my back.

lines.zh: 地上这块，我踩过去才发现。
lines.en: Only noticed it by stepping on it.

lines.zh: 我举起来，对着一点点光看。
lines.en: I hold it to a sliver of light.
Yours. Easy to take.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进泥里，藏起来。
lines.en: I press it into the clay.

lines.zh: 太滑了，我抓两次才抓住。
lines.en: Too smooth. Took two tries.

lines.zh: 这不是我的，但现在没人找。
lines.en: Not mine. Nobody's looking, though.

lines.zh: 我带着它走，不让人看见。
lines.en: I carry it where it can't be seen.
You've entered my angle.
I start from behind.
No running needed. Only waiting.
Your back is open now.

lines.zh: 我把手举到一半就停住。
lines.en: I raise my hand halfway and hold.
These pillars are enough cover.

lines.zh: 你在找正面的人，我不在正面。
lines.en: You're watching the front. I'm not there.

lines.zh: 我选了离你最近的影子。
lines.en: I picked the shadow nearest you.
The line is outside. I'm inside.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，我用来定位。
lines.en: Your footsteps are my map.
Let's begin. I don't like waiting.

lines.zh: 我动手的时候，没人听见。
lines.en: Nobody hears when I strike.
Dark enough here.
Turn around. Face me.
I stay at your rear flank.

lines.zh: 紫染料渗进裂缝，我还在跟。
lines.en: Purple dye seeps into my cracks, and I keep following.
When you turn, I freeze.

lines.zh: 这些柱子中间，我比地面还熟。
lines.en: These pillars. I know them like my hands.
Your weapon's pointed wrong.
I've slowed everything down.

lines.zh: 你身边的人会先看到我。
lines.en: Your companion will see me first.
No hurry. You'll turn eventually.
I've counted to your third step.

lines.zh: 我的紫色在夜里是黑的。
lines.en: My purple is black at night.
You're against the wall. Nowhere left.

lines.zh: 紫色的我，是染料染出来的。
lines.en: I am purple, made so by dye.
You can't hear me now.
Your back is open. Now.
Don't look back. I'm behind you.

lines.zh: 我从背后按住了你的肩。
lines.en: I take your shoulder from behind.
No warning for that.
I pull you half a turn.
My fist comes from low.

lines.zh: 你挡住了正面，侧面空着。
lines.en: You guarded the front. The side was open.

lines.zh: 我贴着你，你的武器伸不开。
lines.en: I'm too close. Your weapon can't swing.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的手上掉了一块。
lines.en: That cost my hand a chunk.
You retreat. I switch sides.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在你眼前晃了一下。
lines.en: A flicker of purple in your eyes.
Pinned. You can't turn.
One more, light.
There's a gap in the back of your armor.
Back into the shadow.
You can't tell which block I'm in.
You went down without seeing me.

lines.zh: 我抓着你的腰带，往旁边一扯。
lines.en: I grab your belt and wrench sideways.

lines.zh: 我被染成紫色，放在阴影里。
lines.en: Dyed purple and set in the shadow.

lines.zh: 我站起来，先看出口在哪。
lines.en: I stand and find the exits first.
This corner suits me.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在暗处不显眼。
lines.en: My color doesn't show in the dark.
I land silent. Crouch first.
Companions up front. I'm behind.
I touch the wall and note the distance.
I crouch first, then rise.

lines.zh: 这层楼上没有别的声音。
lines.en: No other sound on this floor.
I chose the narrowest way.
My shadow clings to the pillar.
Now I wait right here.

lines.zh: 火光下，我的紫色全亮了。
lines.en: In firelight, all my purple showed.
I landed outside the shadow.
Water first loosens the color.

lines.zh: 炸得我贴在墙上，动不了。
lines.en: Pressed flat to the wall.
Something came in from the side.
That light makes hiding impossible.
The clay dries. I shed faster.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整个人被看光了。
lines.en: One flash and I was fully exposed.
Falling. Not even a shadow.
